lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to store questions and answers in parallel lists and write one loop that runs a quiz of any length.
Two lists line up by index: item 2 of questions goes with item 2 of answers.
Together they act like a table.
A single loop asks item i of questions and checks against item i of answers.
To make a new quiz, change the data — not the code.
Professional apps keep content (data) separate from logic (code).
Games load levels from files; quiz apps load questions from databases.
Report score / length of questions so the message is right however many questions there are.
In Python the same engine uses two lists and an index. Change the lists and you have a new quiz.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
